test_sync_training_time_estimator: test SyncTrainingTimeEstimator to calculate synchronous training time from a list of duration events
test_async_training_time_estimator: test AsyncTrainingTimeEstimator to calculate asynchronous training time with custom start times for users
test_get_training_time: test get_training_time function to compute both sync and async training times in one call
test_duration_distribution_from_list: test DurationDistributionFromList to create a training duration distribution from a list of DurationInfo events
test_per_user_uniform_duration: test PerUserUniformDurationDistribution to model uniform training durations per user with configurable mean and min
